Handling if SOME/IP TP segment is received with Offset Value > 0, but no session for this PDU ID and its identified transmission source is running If the API SomeIpTp_RxIndication() is called with the Offset Value is > 0 but no session for the given PDU ID and its identified transmission source (see [SWS_SomeIpTp_00096]) is currently running, • The received PDU shall be ignored • The API Det_ReportRuntimeError() shall be called with the runtime error code SOMEIPTP_E_INCONSISTENT_SEQUENCE.
